newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ Dairy Board lifts milksolids price to $2.90/kg.
newsitem.headline: NZ Dairy Board lifts milksolids price to $2.90/kg.

text.p: The New Zealand Dairy Board said on Friday it had increased its interim milksolids price to $2.90 from $2.70/kg.
The board is still estimating an end-of-season payout within the range of $3.15-3.20/kg.
Board chairman Sir Dryden Spring said that since the start of the season the international dairy market had been weak and unstable.

"While for milk powders and casein, current market conditions are slightly better than earlier in the year and the cheese market is steady, the butter market is difficult with prices unstable," Spring said.
He warned that the outlook for the balance of the season was mixed and the exchange rate was a cause of concern despite the board's very active forward cover programme.
